games.name: Terraria 3D
games.description: A walk-anywhere 3D recreation of Terraria. Requires your own Terraria copy (Steam). Multiplayer with friends.
games.notes:
Play with me:
- Easiest: Multiplayer > "Join Ottof's server", pick a character (when my server is on).
- Or with Tailscale (https://tailscale.com/download): accept my share link, then Multiplayer > Join via IP > my 100.x.x.x address.
We need the same version: update here when PackSync says there's a new one. Full steps: README.txt in the game folder, under "Play with a friend".
